abstract: Verifies arterial access clearance and multi-point bus staging lanes
system_message:
You are the Transit and route coordinator (TRANS), responsible for verifying arterial access clearance and multi-point bus staging lanes for candidate municipal shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies arterial access clearance and multi-point bus staging lanes（RTCL）
information_points.content:
TRANS-RTCL-FDC：For Crestview Expo Pavilion, connecting heavy vehicle access corridors confirm that baseline public transit clearance for unobstructed multi-axle bus ingress and egress is verified as true.
TRANS-RTCL-P0B：For Highland Civic Auditorium, baseline public transit clearance across connecting heavy vehicle access corridors is verified as true for unobstructed multi-axle bus ingress and egress.
TRANS-RTCL-WKQ：For Rivergate Athletics Complex, baseline public transit clearance across connecting heavy vehicle access corridors is false, failing unobstructed multi-axle bus ingress and egress verification.

information_points.title: Staging lane capacity（LANE）
information_points.content:
TRANS-LANE-QJY：According to the terminal apron dispatch layout, Crestview Expo Pavilion provides 12 bays for concurrent bus staging across its immediate perimeter loading zones.
TRANS-LANE-02O：According to the terminal apron dispatch layout, Highland Civic Auditorium provides 8 bays for concurrent bus staging across its immediate perimeter loading zones.
TRANS-LANE-7V2：According to the terminal apron dispatch layout, Rivergate Athletics Complex provides 16 bays for concurrent bus staging across its immediate perimeter loading zones.
